in_sanskrit.name: निथि
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: That which is cool, calm, peaceful, and dark, symbolizing the night, the moon, and the subconscious mind

in_marathi.name: Nithi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nithi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nidh' meaning 'night'. The name Nithi holds the grace and beauty of the night sky and the stars. In Hindu mythology, Nithi is considered a divine name associated with the goddess of night, Lakshmi.

in_bengali.name: Nithi
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Night, Star
in_bengali.long_meaning: Nithi একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nidh' meaning 'night'. The name Nithi holds the grace and beauty of the night sky and the stars. In Hindu mythology, Nithi is considered a divine name associated with the goddess of night, Lakshmi.
